issue : https://github.com/UnityTechnologies/open-project-1/issues/342

**How did you resolve this issue?**  

In interactionManager, I divide the function OnInteractionButtonPress in two  OnInteractionButtonPress and OnInteractionResponseActivated. The last one is associated with a VoidEventChannel named InteractionResponse.

I also create an ActionScript and the associated action named ActiveInteractionResponse_OnEnter which raise the event InteractionResponse.

**How can it be verified that the issue has actually been resolved?**  

Try to pick up an object while you are jumping or attacking
Try to cook and see that you can't.
